subject: Cloudstore marketplace inquiry — quick intro + demo
messages:
From: Natalie Kim <natalie.kim@cloudstore.io>
To: Redwood Inference Sales <sales@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 07 Sep 2026 11:12:00 -0700
Subject: Interested after marketplace listing — short intro + demo?

Hi team,

I work on platform integrations for Cloudstore and we came across your listing on the marketplace this morning. We're evaluating inference options to power semantic search and in-product summarization across our catalog. We liked the latency/cost profile on the listing and would love a short intro + demo to see the product in action.

Rough availability: next week Mon/Tue afternoons PST (1pm-4pm). We're a small pilot team (2 people) and would prefer a 30–45 minute session — demo + quick Q&A.

Can you confirm who would join from Redwood (sales + engineer?) and share a few times? Also, any pre-demo notes or onboarding checklist would be helpful.

Thanks,
Natalie Kim
Platform Integrations | Cloudstore
(natalie.kim@cloudstore.io)
(Attachment: cloudstore-marketplace-inquiry.json)

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.ai>
To: Natalie Kim <natalie.kim@cloudstore.io>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 07 Sep 2026 13:40:23 -0700
Subject: Re: Interested after marketplace listing — short intro + demo?

Hi Natalie — great to hear from you and glad the marketplace listing caught your eye. I'm Vivek on the SDR team — happy to get something on the calendar. Marissa (AE) will join the call and bring an engineer for the deep-dive demo.

I can do a quick 30–45 minute intro; here are three slots that work on our side next week:
- Mon 2026-09-14 1:30pm PT
- Tue 2026-09-15 3:00pm PT
- Tue 2026-09-15 3:30pm PT

If none of those fit, feel free to pick a time from my calendar: https://cal.redwood.ai/vivek/30min

Pre-demo, we'll usually cover:
- brief intros & goals (5m)
- product demo: hosted API + dedicated overview (20m)
- Q&A and next steps (10–20m)

I've attached a one-pager to give you a quick baseline — will follow up with a proposed agenda.

Best,
Vivek Kulkarni
Sales Development Representative
Redwood Inference
(Attachment: Redwood-One-Pager.pdf)

From: Natalie Kim <natalie.kim@cloudstore.io>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 07 Sep 2026 14:02:10 -0700
Subject: Re: Interested after marketplace listing — short intro + demo?

Thanks Vivek — appreciate the quick reply. Tue 2026-09-15 at 3:00pm PT would work best for us, but one of our engineers has a conflict and asked whether we could move to Thu 2026-09-17 at 10:00am PT instead.

Suggested agenda from our side:
- 10m: goals + architecture overview (we'll share our current flow)
- 20m: demo focusing on embeddings + streaming generation
- 10m: pricing/next steps

Also, could you confirm whether Redwood will cover SOC 2 / data handling during the call? Our procurement team will want to know ahead of time.

Phone: +1 (415) 555-0182

Cheers,
Natalie
(Attachment: cloudstore-pilot-notes.txt)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Natalie Kim <natalie.kim@cloudstore.io>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 07 Sep 2026 14:30:45 -0700
Subject: Re: Interested after marketplace listing — quick intro + demo?

Hi Natalie — Marissa here, AE for platform deals. Thu 2026-09-17 at 10:00am PT works for me; I'll bring Sam (infra engineer) who can demo embeddings and streaming.

Agenda looks good — I'll add a short security slide to cover SOC 2, data retention, and private deployment options. Quick ask: can you share a very short summary of your current latency and throughput targets (tokens/sec or requests/sec) so Sam can tailor the demo?

I'll also upload a simple pre-demo checklist to the shared drive (link to follow) and drop a short pricing snapshot for pilots.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
(Attachment: redwood-demo-agenda.md)

From: Natalie Kim <natalie.kim@cloudstore.io>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 07 Sep 2026 16:05:12 -0700
Subject: Re: Interested after marketplace listing — quick intro + demo?

Perfect — Thu 10:00am PT confirmed on our side as well. For targets: we're aiming for 200–300 QPS for embeddings during peak syncs (batching accepted) and sub-150ms p95 generation latency for short summaries (~120 tokens). Hope that helps.

Procurement note: we generally need a vendor contact and preliminary pricing to route to our legal/procurement team. If you can attach a pilot pricing snapshot that would be great.

Thanks — looking forward to meeting the team.
Natalie
(Attachment: cloudstore-targets.xlsx)
